pages.text: The Proto-Hivemind is an extremely dangerous entity, and it is recommended to make sure you are prepared before letting a Reconstructed Mind evolve into one. It will attempt to send dangerous creatures to your location, and anything in a radius of 50 blocks around the Proto Hivemind should be viewed as perpetually infested territory.

In addition to the multiplication of Spore creatures you might already be familiar with, the Proto-Hivemind comes with many other dangers. Read the other entries of this chapter to learn more about them and prepare accordingly.
